method: real headless Chrome; every .model-loader driven to ready (session creation instantiates the runtime); per-request URLs and encoded bytes attributed to transformers.js / raw ORT / model weights; desktop + mobile; single-runtime overview as control
caveats: Warm-cache run: runtime files already in the profile's HTTP cache are often not re-requested, so runtime byte columns read 0 for some rows. The runtime file SETS are the evidence (each multi-model desktop row lists both runtimes); byte costs come from the payload table below (jsdelivr content-length).

The artifact's classifier grouped Hugging Face's Xet CAS hosts (us.aws.cdn.hf.co, cas-bridge.xethub-eu.hf.co) under 'other'; this file re-buckets them into model-weights. The committed script has the fixed classifier.
Mobile passes reuse the desktop engines/HTTP cache; viewport does not change which runtimes are imported (same page code).
